We will produce an evidence-based guide to (1) climate orgs with high impact per dollar, (2) the most effective political advocacy/lobbying groups, and (3) individual/community actions with measurable impact.

## Approach (two-axis)
- **Reduce uncertainty first** by defining a common evaluation framework (impact metrics, evidence quality, geography, time horizon, and attribution caveats).
- **Reduce remaining work in parallel** by delegating deep research for each of the three domains to sub-agents, then synthesizing into a single, comparable set of recommendations.

## Deliverable
